[Trend Position]
· Current price ($68.17) vs SMA5/20/50 ($91.21/$109.23/$119.99): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· SMA100/200 ($146.12/$124.23) position: Maintaining strong long-term downtrend.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.6→31.6) + Oversold reading + Continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -5.2565→-2.8932) + Improving diagnosis + Downward trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $57.55) + Bandwidth widened to 94.63% then starting to contract.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($49.33) + Basis (based on Pivot S1).
· Swing resistance ($70.86) + Potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High) + Interpretation of weakening signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.31x) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend) + Conditions for entry/wait: RSI recovery above 45 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
